Unscramble Words

See every word you can spell from your letters, with longer words first.

Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is uploaded.

Words you can spell will show up here.

Words from the ENABLE word list. Not an official tournament word list.

Offensive words are hidden. Letters filled by a ? or * wildcard are underlined.

Up to 15 letters, plus at most 2 wildcards (? or *). The list shows 500 words at a time.

How to use

  1. Type or paste letters into "Your letters". Spaces and commas are removed for you.

  2. Leave "Any length" selected, or choose "Use all letters", and set "Shortest word".

  3. Press "Find words", then press "Copy all" or click a word to copy it.

Example

Alex is stuck on a paper puzzle. The letters on the card are written P, L, O, E.

BeforeAfter
 
P, L, O, E
4 letters: pole, lope
3 letters: lop, pol, ope, ole

FAQ

Why are some 4-letter words listed before 3-letter words?

Common words come first inside each length. A lower everyday-use score means a more common word. Longer lengths are listed before shorter ones.

What does the underline on a letter mean?

A ? or * can stand for any letter, up to two of them. The underlined letter is the one the wildcard filled in.

Why is a word I know missing?

The list is ENABLE, a public-domain word list. It is not a tournament list, and it has no names. Offensive words are hidden, and the result says how many were hidden.

How is this different from the other letter page?

This page starts on Any length, so shorter words are listed too. Anagram Solver starts on Use all letters.

What if it says no words were found?

Take out a letter, lower Shortest word, or add a ? wildcard, then press Find words again.
